evals.name: dashboard-query-caching
evals.prompt: The revenue report refetches on every tab switch. Tune TanStack Query for luxe-front without bypassing Orval.
evals.expected_output: Uses staleTime on useGetAdminReportsRevenue, references query-client defaults, does not add axios or Zustand for report data.
assertions: Response uses Orval-generated hook not raw fetch
Response mentions staleTime or query options
Response does not store report data in Zustand

evals.name: chart-bundle
evals.prompt: Admin dashboard with Recharts feels heavy on first load. Optimize bundle for luxe-front.
evals.expected_output: Suggests next/dynamic for chart sections, direct recharts imports, ChartContainer pattern; respects React Compiler.
assertions: Response mentions next/dynamic or conditional load
Response references ChartContainer or revenue-daily-chart pattern
Response does not add useCallback/useMemo everywhere as default fix
